document.title: PER-12/PJ/2026: Perubahan PER-11/PJ/2025 (pelaporan SPT di Coretax)

delta.note: The document amends PER-11/PJ/2025 only in reporting and administrative respects. It covers the mechanism for correcting SPT returns (pembetulan) for SPT Masa PPh 21/26, Unifikasi, PPN and the annual returns, the adjustment of overpayment compensation balances, and the appointment of officials to sign withholding slips. It does not change any rate, threshold, table, deduction, rounding, or calculation step for computing PPh 21 owed by permanent employees.
